fields.Name: Common: Directory Dashboard Summary
fields.UserQuestion: How many people, organizations, relationships, and directory gaps are there right now — without a row cap?
fields.Description: Directory dashboard KPI tiles as a single row of scalars. Replaces in-browser counts over a RunView MaxRows=1000 snapshot, which under-counted once the party file grew past a thousand people.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: one row. COUNT(*) / SUM(CASE) over vwPeople, vwOrganizations, vwRelationships. Email gap matches PersonEmail() (COALESCE PrimaryEmail, Email). People-per-day is business days on __mj_CreatedAt (fnBusinessDayOf against fnBusinessToday().Today, the BizApps business time zone). Org type mix is FOR JSON PATH. No template parameters — pushing twice must not collide on QueryParameter.
